verdict.rationale: Gmail filters check incoming mail against criteria such as sender, subject or size. They can add labels or forward the message to a specified address, so a team-lead can route mail to teammates with rules. Delegation gives others shared access to read, send and delete mail, but it does not assign ownership of individual conversations, and the pack shows no assignment feature. Missing for 10: native per-conversation assignment to a teammate, visible owner/status tracking, shared-inbox collaboration features, independent corroboration.
